dimensions.assessment: Directly involves the Oglala Sioux Tribe and the Cheyenne River Sioux Tribe regarding a specific 40-acre parcel of land.
dimensions.evidence: restricted fee status for the Oglala Sioux Tribe and the Cheyenne River Sioux Tribe

dimensions.assessment: Changes land status to restricted fee, protecting it from state/local taxation, transfer without consent, and prohibiting commercial development and gaming.
dimensions.evidence: shall not be subject to taxation by a State or local government... shall not be used for gaming activity

importance_detail.rationale: Directs the Department of the Interior to place approximately 40 acres of land in South Dakota into restricted fee status for the Oglala Sioux Tribe and Cheyenne River Sioux Tribe to be maintained as a memorial and sacred site.
